mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5% month-over-month indicates robust consumer confidence and construction activity, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST increases by at least 1.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 20 days following the second consecutive month of FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the average return is positive or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% month-over-month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and weakening consumer demand, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and RSAFS occurs in 100+ months, but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a monthly CPI acceleration exceeding 0.2% triggers aggressive central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%
failure_condition: In the 60 days following CPIAUCSL acceleration, average 60-day return is positive or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.8% month-over-month reflects robust manufacturing activity and business investment, which typically supports near-term corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months where INDPRO increases by at least 0.8% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the 20 days following the second consecutive month of UNRATE > 4.5%, average return is positive or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.0% month-over-month indicates broad-based economic weakness in consumer demand and manufacturing output, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO occurs in 100+ months, but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of those months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5%), a deceleration in GDP growth below 1.5% annualized signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.5% and GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%
failure_condition: In the 60 days following GDPC1 deceleration below 1.5% after growth >2.5%, average 60-day return is positive or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
